law_name: Law No. 22 of 2006 on the Protection of Copyright and Neighboring Rights (as amended up to Law No. 5 of 2014)
moral_rights: Art. 5: perpetual, imprescriptible and inalienable rights of attribution, anonymity/pseudonym and integrity (bar distortion harming honour/reputation)
digital_protection: TPM provisions adopted under US FTA (IIPA flags compliance gaps) (unconfirmed)
fair_use_exceptions: Art. 19(1) single private copy subject to three-step test; Art. 20(1) quotation for legitimate purpose; Art. 20(2) teaching illustration by non-profit bodies
registration_required: No (voluntary registration with the Copyright Protection Office)
enforcement_body: Copyright Protection Office, Ministry of Information
notes: Term: some sources give life + 50 (probably the superseded 1993 law); recent summaries give life + 70
